list.name: model
list.label: Model
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT model AS __text, model AS __value FROM claude.api_calls WHERE model IS NOT NULL ORDER BY model

list.name: agent
list.label: Agent
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT coalesce(nullif(agent_type,''),'unknown') AS __text, coalesce(nullif(agent_type,''),'unknown') AS __value FROM claude.api_calls ORDER BY 1

list.name: small_sessions
list.label: Small sessions
list.description: A session counts as small if it lasted under 30 seconds or made fewer than 5 API calls. Off (default) hides these from every panel below; switch to On to include them.

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(sum(c.total_input_tokens),0) + coalesce(sum(c.output_tokens),0) AS total_tokens FROM claude.api_calls c WHERE $__timeFilter(c.called_at) AND ('${model:csv}' = '' OR c.model = ANY(string_to_array('${model:csv}', ','))) AND ('${agent:csv}' = '' OR coalesce(nullif(c.agent_type,''),'unknown') = ANY(string_to_array('${agent:csv}', ','))) AND ('$small_sessions' = 'on' OR c.session_id IN (SELECT session_id FROM claude.v_session_size_flags WHERE NOT is_small))

panels.title: Duplicated tokens (/stats)
panels.description: Mirrors Claude Code's own /stats non-deduplicated arithmetic (dailyModelTokens in ~/.claude/stats-cache.json); expected to exceed "Total tokens", which is the deduplicated truth.

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(sum(c.duplicated_total_tokens),0) AS duplicated_tokens FROM claude.api_calls c WHERE $__timeFilter(c.called_at) AND ('${model:csv}' = '' OR c.model = ANY(string_to_array('${model:csv}', ','))) AND ('${agent:csv}' = '' OR coalesce(nullif(c.agent_type,''),'unknown') = ANY(string_to_array('${agent:csv}', ','))) AND ('$small_sessions' = 'on' OR c.session_id IN (SELECT session_id FROM claude.v_session_size_flags WHERE NOT is_small))

SELECT coalesce(sum(c.cache_write_tokens),0) AS cache_write_tokens FROM claude.api_calls c WHERE $__timeFilter(c.called_at) AND ('${model:csv}' = '' OR c.model = ANY(string_to_array('${model:csv}', ','))) AND ('${agent:csv}' = '' OR coalesce(nullif(c.agent_type,''),'unknown') = ANY(string_to_array('${agent:csv}', ','))) AND ('$small_sessions' = 'on' OR c.session_id IN (SELECT session_id FROM claude.v_session_size_flags WHERE NOT is_small))

SELECT count(DISTINCT c.session_id) AS total_sessions FROM claude.api_calls c WHERE $__timeFilter(c.called_at) AND ('${model:csv}' = '' OR c.model = ANY(string_to_array('${model:csv}', ','))) AND ('${agent:csv}' = '' OR coalesce(nullif(c.agent_type,''),'unknown') = ANY(string_to_array('${agent:csv}', ','))) AND ('$small_sessions' = 'on' OR c.session_id IN (SELECT session_id FROM claude.v_session_size_flags WHERE NOT is_small))

SELECT count(*) AS total_api_calls FROM claude.api_calls c WHERE $__timeFilter(c.called_at) AND ('${model:csv}' = '' OR c.model = ANY(string_to_array('${model:csv}', ','))) AND ('${agent:csv}' = '' OR coalesce(nullif(c.agent_type,''),'unknown') = ANY(string_to_array('${agent:csv}', ','))) AND ('$small_sessions' = 'on' OR c.session_id IN (SELECT session_id FROM claude.v_session_size_flags WHERE NOT is_small))

SELECT round(sum(c.cache_read_tokens)::numeric / NULLIF(sum(c.total_input_tokens),0) * 100, 2) AS cache_read_pct FROM claude.api_calls c WHERE $__timeFilter(c.called_at) AND ('${model:csv}' = '' OR c.model = ANY(string_to_array('${model:csv}', ','))) AND ('${agent:csv}' = '' OR coalesce(nullif(c.agent_type,''),'unknown') = ANY(string_to_array('${agent:csv}', ','))) AND ('$small_sessions' = 'on' OR c.session_id IN (SELECT session_id FROM claude.v_session_size_flags WHERE NOT is_small))

SELECT coalesce(sum(s.duration_seconds),0) AS total_duration_seconds FROM claude.v_session_token_summary s WHERE $__timeFilter(s.first_event_at) AND ('${model:csv}' = '' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM claude.api_calls c WHERE c.session_id = s.session_id AND c.model = ANY(string_to_array('${model:csv}', ',')))) AND ('${agent:csv}' = '' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM claude.api_calls c WHERE c.session_id = s.session_id AND coalesce(nullif(c.agent_type,''),'unknown') = ANY(string_to_array('${agent:csv}', ',')))) AND ('$small_sessions' = 'on' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM claude.v_session_size_flags f WHERE f.session_id = s.session_id AND NOT f.is_small))

SELECT round(avg(s.duration_seconds), 1) AS avg_duration_seconds FROM claude.v_session_token_summary s WHERE $__timeFilter(s.first_event_at) AND ('${model:csv}' = '' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM claude.api_calls c WHERE c.session_id = s.session_id AND c.model = ANY(string_to_array('${model:csv}', ',')))) AND ('${agent:csv}' = '' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM claude.api_calls c WHERE c.session_id = s.session_id AND coalesce(nullif(c.agent_type,''),'unknown') = ANY(string_to_array('${agent:csv}', ',')))) AND ('$small_sessions' = 'on' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM claude.v_session_size_flags f WHERE f.session_id = s.session_id AND NOT f.is_small))

SELECT round(avg(c.delta_seconds), 1) AS avg_call_duration_seconds FROM claude.api_calls c WHERE $__timeFilter(c.called_at) AND c.call_index > 1 AND ('${model:csv}' = '' OR c.model = ANY(string_to_array('${model:csv}', ','))) AND ('${agent:csv}' = '' OR coalesce(nullif(c.agent_type,''),'unknown') = ANY(string_to_array('${agent:csv}', ','))) AND ('$small_sessions' = 'on' OR c.session_id IN (SELECT session_id FROM claude.v_session_size_flags WHERE NOT is_small))

panels.title: Est. API cost (tracked tokens)
panels.description: List-price estimate of what these calls would have cost on the API (claude.v_api_call_cost, deduplicated tokens). Not a Claude Pro bill. Calls for an unpriced model are excluded from this sum, not costed at 0.

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(sum(cost_usd),0) AS est_cost_usd FROM claude.v_api_call_cost c WHERE $__timeFilter(c.called_at) AND ('${model:csv}' = '' OR c.model = ANY(string_to_array('${model:csv}', ','))) AND ('${agent:csv}' = '' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM claude.api_calls a WHERE a.call_id = c.call_id AND coalesce(nullif(a.agent_type,''),'unknown') = ANY(string_to_array('${agent:csv}', ',')))) AND ('$small_sessions' = 'on' OR c.session_id IN (SELECT session_id FROM claude.v_session_size_flags WHERE NOT is_small))

panels.title: Est. API cost (/stats arithmetic)
panels.description: List-price estimate using Claude Code's own /stats non-deduplicated arithmetic (claude.v_api_call_cost_duplicated). Expected to exceed "Est. API cost (tracked tokens)" -- that is correct, not a bug. Not a Claude Pro bill; calls for an unpriced model are excluded, not costed at 0.

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(sum(cost_usd),0) AS est_cost_usd_duplicated FROM claude.v_api_call_cost_duplicated c WHERE $__timeFilter(c.called_at) AND ('${model:csv}' = '' OR c.model = ANY(string_to_array('${model:csv}', ','))) AND ('${agent:csv}' = '' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM claude.api_calls a WHERE a.call_id = c.call_id AND coalesce(nullif(a.agent_type,''),'unknown') = ANY(string_to_array('${agent:csv}', ',')))) AND ('$small_sessions' = 'on' OR c.session_id IN (SELECT session_id FROM claude.v_session_size_flags WHERE NOT is_small))

panels.title: Avg context window (per API call)
panels.description: Average billed context window per API call: avg(total_input_tokens), i.e. input + cache-read + cache-write, which is exactly the prompt size sent to the model. Per-call grain (not per-session peak) so it matches the other stats on this row and honours the model filter directly.

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(avg(c.total_input_tokens), 0) AS avg_context_window_tokens FROM claude.api_calls c WHERE $__timeFilter(c.called_at) AND ('${model:csv}' = '' OR c.model = ANY(string_to_array('${model:csv}', ','))) AND ('${agent:csv}' = '' OR coalesce(nullif(c.agent_type,''),'unknown') = ANY(string_to_array('${agent:csv}', ','))) AND ('$small_sessions' = 'on' OR c.session_id IN (SELECT session_id FROM claude.v_session_size_flags WHERE NOT is_small))

SELECT gs AS time, coalesce(sum(c.total_input_tokens),0) AS total_input_tokens, coalesce(sum(c.output_tokens),0) AS output_tokens FROM generate_series(date_trunc('minute', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz), $__timeTo()::timestamptz, CASE WHEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz < interval '10 minutes' THEN interval '1 minute' WHEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz < interval '30 minutes' THEN interval '2 minutes' WHEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz < interval '1 hour' THEN interval '5 minutes' WHEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz < interval '3 hours' THEN interval '10 minutes' WHEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz < interval '12 hours' THEN interval '30 minutes' WHEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz < interval '2 days' THEN interval '1 hour' WHEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz < interval '7 days' THEN interval '2 hours' ELSE interval '1 day' END) gs LEFT JOIN claude.api_calls c ON c.called_at >= gs AND c.called_at < gs + CASE WHEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz < interval '10 minutes' THEN interval '1 minute' WHEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz < interval '30 minutes' THEN interval '2 minutes' WHEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz < interval '1 hour' THEN interval '5 minutes' WHEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz < interval '3 hours' THEN interval '10 minutes' WHEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz < interval '12 hours' THEN interval '30 minutes' WHEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz < interval '2 days' THEN interval '1 hour' WHEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz < interval '7 days' THEN interval '2 hours' ELSE interval '1 day' END AND ('${model:csv}' = '' OR c.model = ANY(string_to_array('${model:csv}', ','))) AND ('${agent:csv}' = '' OR coalesce(nullif(c.agent_type,''),'unknown') = ANY(string_to_array('${agent:csv}', ','))) AND ('$small_sessions' = 'on' OR c.session_id IN (SELECT session_id FROM claude.v_session_size_flags WHERE NOT is_small)) GROUP BY gs ORDER BY gs

$__timeFrom()::timestamptz < interval '1 hour' THEN interval '5 minutes' WHEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz < interval '3 hours' THEN interval '10 minutes' WHEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz < interval '7 days' THEN interval '2 hours' ELSE interval '1 day' END AND ('${model:csv}' = '' OR c.model = ANY(string_to_array('${model:csv}', ','))) AND ('${agent:csv}' = '' OR coalesce(nullif(c.agent_type,''),'unknown') = ANY(string_to_array('${agent:csv}', ','))) AND ('$small_sessions' = 'on' OR c.session_id IN (SELECT session_id FROM claude.v_session_size_flags WHERE NOT is_small)) GROUP BY gs ORDER BY gs

SELECT s.session_id, s.ai_title, s.total_input_tokens, s.output_tokens, s.cache_read_pct, s.api_calls, s.duration_seconds, m.max_context_growth, m.max_time_api_calls FROM claude.v_session_token_summary s LEFT JOIN claude.v_session_context_metrics m USING (session_id) WHERE $__timeFilter(s.first_event_at) AND ('${model:csv}' = '' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM claude.api_calls c WHERE c.session_id = s.session_id AND c.model = ANY(string_to_array('${model:csv}', ',')))) AND ('${agent:csv}' = '' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM claude.api_calls c WHERE c.session_id = s.session_id AND coalesce(nullif(c.agent_type,''),'unknown') = ANY(string_to_array('${agent:csv}', ',')))) AND ('$small_sessions' = 'on' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM claude.v_session_size_flags f WHERE f.session_id = s.session_id AND NOT f.is_small)) ORDER BY s.first_event_at DESC
